reason: The plugin is primarily a web search integration tool for DeepSeek Harness, replacing or selecting the default web search provider with AnySearch via a native WebSearchProvider that calls AnySearch /v1/search and returns result metadata. Evidence shows dedicated configuration via a web settings section, optional headless support, and profile patching for enabling/disabling the provider, so classification focuses on search-browsing with external-service integration and moderate risk from networked search calls plus profile/configuration changes.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供一个原生 AnySearch Web 搜索提供者，用于在 Web 与 Headless 场景下进行网页检索并将结果返回给 web_search 工具。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a native AnySearch web search provider to DeepSeek Harness, enabling web search in both Web and Headless modes through the web_search workflow.

capabilities: Executes web search requests through AnySearch /v1/search
Provides a DeepSeek Harness web_search provider integration
Stores and reads provider configuration via credential references
Adds and removes profile-specific plugin registration and overrides
Supports both Web UI and headless usage paths
